{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are consistently below true outcomes, showing a persistent downward bias that exceeds 1-2 euros in early periods",
    "The gap between model and true values narrows systematically from day 1-10, suggesting lag rather than permanent bias",
    "Days 11-20 show model values increasingly overestimate reality, while days 21-30 demonstrate model is still below actual prices by 1-3 euros",
    "High sentiment (>=0.67) correlates with model underestimating prices by 0.5-1.0 euros, suggesting sentiment momentum is partially captured with lag",
    "Low sentiment (<=0.33) regions show least divergence between model and outcomes, indicating accuracy improves during sentiment consolidation",
    "The model exhibits mean-reversion tendencies that are too aggressive, particularly at 30-day horizons where true prices maintain trends longer than predicted",
    "Forecasts at day 15-20 region show the smallest model-outcome divergence, suggesting the model is most accurate in the middle of its 30-day horizon"
] }
